From: Alex Heath <alex.heath@acme-analytics.com>

Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API evaluation - interested in a demo

Hi Marissa,

I signed up for a Hosted API evaluation yesterday and I was routed here for a quick product demo. We're evaluating Redwood for a proof-of-concept around low-latency text classification and reranking for search results.

High-level: Acme Analytics processes short user queries (avg 35 tokens) and needs sub-200ms p50 token latency, with predictable unit costs. We have a small pilot (~50k requests/month) to start.

Would love a 30-minute demo this week to see the hosted API and ask a few infra questions. My availability (PDT): Thu 7/9 10:00-12:00, 15:00-17:00; Fri 7/10 morning.

I've attached a short pre-demo questionnaire.

Thanks,
Alex Heath
Senior Data Product Manager
Acme Analytics
